description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType that implements the EntityIdWithResourceType interface. It provides methods to create, parse, and access entity IDs combined with resource type information, including serialization and equality operations.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType
classes.description: An immutable implementation of EntityIdWithResourceType holding a resource type string, an EntityId, and optional cache lookup context, with serialization, comparison, and parsing functionality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an EntityIdWithResourceType instance from a resource type and EntityId, without cache lookup context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an EntityIdWithResourceType instance from resource type, EntityId, and cache lookup context.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes an EntityIdWithResourceType from its string representation, expecting a format of resourceType:id.

methods.name: getCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cache lookup context if present.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on resourceType, id, and cacheLookupContext.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on resourceType, id, and cacheLookupContext.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation in the format resourceType:id.
